text.card: A red giant 2,967 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.87 solar masses and 8.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,664 K at its surface.
